Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that investigates the impact of scale (spatial extent, cell size, neighborhood configuration) on the behavior of a cellular automata model (CLUE-S) used for land use change modeling. While it involves land use change simulation, its primary objective is not LULC prediction itself but rather sensitivity analysis of model behavior under varying scale parameters. The study area includes Beijing Province and Miyun County—both subnational (regional/local) scales—and explicitly does not cover an entire country. It simulates land use change between 1991 and 2004 (i.e., historical calibration/validation), with no future projections or scenarios beyond 2004. Furthermore, it uses only one realization (no ≥2 future scenarios) and focuses on methodological implications of scale rather than producing national-scale LULC predictions. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria: not national-scale, no future scenarios, and LULC prediction is a tool rather than the central research goal.)
